title.narrative: Technical Cooperation Facility and Support to Civil Society Programme (TECCSO)

description.narrative: The Action will help address the issues of limited capacities in national administration in Tonga, limited capacities of Civil Society Organisations and limited linkages between CSOs and Government in development cooperation. It will contribute to achieving the priorities set in the Tonga Strategic Development Framework and help achieve key Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) notably on Gender (SDG5), on energy (SDG7), inclusive society for development (SDG16) and objectives 17,18 and 19 of the Gender Action Plan II.
